mainEntity.name: What is custom home builder marketing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Custom home builder marketing is the coordinated work of positioning a builder, earning visibility, explaining the buying and building process, proving credibility, and turning right-fit interest into qualified conversations.

mainEntity.name: Should a builder rely on referrals?

acceptedAnswer.text: Referrals are valuable and often high quality, but they do not provide predictable control over timing, market reach, or project fit. Search, content, proof, and follow-up should strengthen referrals and create additional discovery paths.

mainEntity.name: How long does SEO take for a custom home builder?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is no reliable universal timeline. Technical condition, current authority, competition, geography, content quality, implementation speed, and sales-cycle length all matter. Leading indicators may change within weeks of crawling, while meaningful qualified demand usually requires consistent work over months.

mainEntity.name: Can BigOrange guarantee placement in AI search answers?

acceptedAnswer.text: No responsible agency can guarantee placement in a changing generated answer. BigOrange can improve controllable factors such as crawl access, indexability, clarity, evidence, entity consistency, structured data, corroboration, and measurement.

mainEntity.name: What should a custom home builder website include?

acceptedAnswer.text: A custom home builder website should include a clear audience and market statement, curated project stories, process, people, qualification guidance, approved proof, useful FAQs, and a low-pressure next step. It must also work quickly and accessibly on a phone.
